text:
Priya: hey all, new hire trouble. I can connect to WireGuard but any 10.4.x.x address resolves to my home router/admin page instead of the internal service. example: http://10.4.1.10 opens my router UI. anyone run into local CIDR overlap?
Jordan: welcome Priya! yup, classic home-cidr conflict. many consumer routers default to 10.4.0.0/24 or 10.0.x.x. can you paste `ip addr` and `ip route` (or `ifconfig`/`route -n`) and the local router IP?
Priya: sure:
```
$ ip addr show
3: wg0: <POINTOPOINT,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1420 qdisc noqueue state UNKNOWN group default qlen 1000
    inet 10.4.5.33/32 scope global wg0
$ ip route show
default via 192.168.0.1 dev eth0
10.4.0.0/16 dev wg0 scope link
```
Priya: local router IP is 10.4.1.1 (I changed it ages ago). so packets to 10.4.1.10 never hit wireguard because my LAN responds first.
devops-bot: Note: account policy: split-tunnel. assigned ip: 10.4.5.33. CIDR overlap detected: client local gateway 10.4.1.1 conflicts with VPN range 10.4.0.0/16.
Lucy: two options: (1) change your home LAN subnet (e.g., set router to 192.168.50.1) — simplest if you control the router; (2) on laptop add a higher-priority route for specific internal hosts via wg0 (only works if you know host IPs); (3) use bastion SSH jump or corporate forced-tunnel profile until you can renumber.
Jordan: example of specific host route (run as admin/root):
```
sudo ip route add 10.4.1.10/32 dev wg0 via 0.0.0.0
```
Jordan: or on macOS: `sudo route -n add -host 10.4.1.10 -interface wg0`
Priya: I don't want to mess with my family wifi. Is there a quick workaround?
NetHelp: for onboarding we tag affected users with `force-tunnel-temp` so they get a full-tunnel profile until they can change home LAN. file a ticket with ONB-5120 and request `home-cidr-conflict` flag. That will provision a temporary profile that routes all traffic via Redwood VPN.
Priya: OK opened ticket ONB-5120. Also fingers crossed switching router DHCP to 192.168.50.1 is doable tonight.
Lucy: welcome aboard Priya. ping me after you update the ticket and we can flip you to split-tunnel once verified. Also FYI bastion SSH works regardless so you can access services right now with `ssh -J bastionsvc@bastion.redwood 10.4.1.10`.
Priya: thanks everyone, using bastion for now and will update ticket. really appreciate the quick help :smile:
